ValidationRule.description: 3 sales process fields need to be entered when closing and opportunity
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Won"),
OR( ISBLANK (Current_State__c), ISBLANK (Future_State__c), ISBLANK ( Gap__c ) ), OR( RecordType.Name = "Accelerated-State Farm") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please complete the "Current State", "Future State", and "Gap" fields when the stage is Closed Won
